description: AdsAgent helps advertising operators inspect Meta performance, manage reusable launch templates, prepare campaign changes, and execute explicitly confirmed Meta advertising actions through ChatGPT. OAuth connects to the operator's own AdsAgent workspace; advertising delivery changes require explicit confirmation, and workspace templates and settings can be edited directly at the user's request. AdsAgent never asks for health, payment-card, government-ID, or biometric data.

defaultPrompt: Show Meta account-level performance for my selected product over the last 7 completed days.
Diagnose why my selected Meta product is not delivering and recommend safe next steps.
Prepare a paused Meta campaign from my template and creatives, then wait for my approval before creating it.
